family_dispositions.rationale: The architecture requires whole-discipline coverage and bidirectional lifecycle/configuration trace, while SWEBOK remains a knowledge map rather than Ranex process authority.
The retained Chapter 5 practices apply to local design, complexity containment, ownership and narrow contracts; absent chapters confer no authority.
Owned adapters, one composition path and verified refactoring are selected, while language- and TDD-era heuristics remain contextual.
Single semantic ownership, change locality, rollback/strangler paths and production-shaped tracers are architectural controls; dated tooling advice is not imported.
Scope/decomposition/deep-dive/reconciliation and measured pattern fit inform the design; interview examples and scale patterns are not defaults.
Acceptance examples, risk-layered verification, and the estimate-versus-commitment boundary are applied as architecture controls. Runtime enactment remains separately unassessed.
The local reliability, time, fencing, outbox, replay and idempotency guidance applies with explicit security/privacy/operations supplementation and no exactly-once overclaim.
Characteristics, fitness, explicit tradeoffs, boundary/coupling analysis and ADR-governed modular-monolith selection are applicable; qualitative star ratings are not Ranex scores.
Capability-visible organization, costed boundaries, inward dependencies, process-split restraint and production-safe testability apply without treating one package layout as universal.

Change/comprehension symptoms, deep public interfaces, semantic information ownership and alternatives for consequential design decisions apply as qualitative diagnostics with subject-specific evidence, not as a scalar architecture score.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The architecture maps governance, requirements, design, build, verification, release, operations, maintenance, security, quality, configuration and improvement to named documents, contexts, gates and evidence homes.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Knowledge-area coverage is not standards-clause conformity or runtime proof.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Requirements, architecture decisions, configuration baselines, implementation, tests, releases, operations and maintenance consequences are connected by governed identifiers and immutable evidence.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Ranex lifecycle controls, not SWEBOK alone, define authority and exact transitions.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Local design may evolve during construction only through bounded alternatives, architecture checks and normal change authority.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Emergent local design cannot create authority, security, persistence or recovery policy outside accepted change control.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Essential authority, failure and recovery complexity is explicit while framework folders, empty layers, god services and arbitrary size gates are rejected.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Simplicity cannot omit denial, authority, failure, recovery or lifecycle behavior.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Contexts own narrow APIs and ports and hide domain, persistence, adapter and wire mechanisms from consumers.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The complete fail-closed path ownership contract is defined; production path enactment and ownership evidence remain NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Vendor, provider, database, delivery and legacy types are translated by owner-defined adapters behind named ports with parity and failure tests.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: A wrapper alone does not prove security, protocol correctness or recovery.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Only bootstrap/composition.py selects release-profile implementations; imports and context factories cannot choose global authority or policy.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Dependency injection is a means; exact configuration and authority selection remain the control objective.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The default construction loop permits small structural improvements only after relevant behavior passes and architecture checks remain green.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Local cleanliness cannot compensate for a failed architecture, security or lifecycle gate.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Accepted prose owns meaning, registries own executable vocabulary, and schemas/bindings/docs are generated or drift-validated rather than independently maintained.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: DRY cannot create shared domain ownership, shared tables or a god service.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Context APIs, owned state and inward dependency rules are intended to localize changes and make necessary coupling explicit.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Perfect independence is neither possible nor required; necessary coupling is explicitly registered and runtime change-spread evidence remains NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The modular monolith, port boundaries, upstream strangler, context-local migrations, rollback and retirement rules preserve explicit exit paths.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Optionality has cost; runtime migration and rollback rehearsal remain required.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Initial implementation routes are production-shaped end-to-end tracers that preserve the full destination map and explicitly retain missing coverage; ADR-0010 preserves the exact inherited test baseline only as nonsealing characterization evidence while replacement proceeds in canonical slices.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: A tracer is not complete-product, MVP, disposable-prototype or runtime-readiness evidence; running an inherited baseline test does not prove Ranex behavior, migration, architecture conformance or gate PASS.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The architecture records scope and quality needs, a complete decomposition, authority/failure deep dives, alternatives and unresolved gates.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The interview method does not prove completeness and its time box is not Ranex policy.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Ranex selects local/static/synchronous defaults and requires evidence-triggered substitution rather than importing web-scale patterns.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Simplified examples and absent measured runtime load cannot justify distributed scale mechanisms.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Owned requirements carry executable acceptance and rejection examples without transferring acceptance authority to the implementer.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Examples clarify but do not replace requirements, risk analysis or human acceptance.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Every material risk maps to the lowest-cost convincing lane while retaining required integration, security, resilience, recovery and operations evidence.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Fixed pyramid percentages and universal coverage targets are rejected.

practice_applications.design_behavior: SDLC-EST-001 makes estimates immutable non-authoritative uncertainty observations and recognizes a delivery commitment only through one current authenticated HumanDecisionRecord bound to exact plan, scope, estimates, capacity, dependencies, risk, acceptance basis, owner, window and recommit triggers.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: This is a design-definition claim only. No runtime EstimateObservation, commitment decision, READY caller, rejection path or recommitment event has been assessed, and a commitment decision cannot compensate for a failed gate or prove delivery.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Reliability, latency, capacity, recovery, security, privacy, retention and evolvability have named baselines, distributions and evidence gates.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The incomplete local DDIA copy does not provide security, privacy, release or management controls; Ranex sources do.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Wall time, monotonic elapsed time, deadlines, leases and test clocks are distinct typed sources behind declared ports and clock-jump/suspend tests.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Monotonic clocks do not make lease ownership safe after process pauses; fencing is separate.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Protected writes, leases, mailboxes, budgets, tools and effects require epoch/fencing checks at the resource or sink beyond the worker.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Fencing does not replace authentication, authorization, sandboxing or hostile-worker controls.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Each owner defines its local atomic record/outbox boundary, ordered public events, at-least-once duplicates, replay and reconciliation without shared-table transactions.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: CDC and distributed brokers are examples, not required technologies.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Commands are validated before immutable events; deterministic reducers, snapshots, replay, retention, correction and erasure semantics are separately owned and tested.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Retain-all assumptions are subordinate to privacy, legal hold and bounded retention.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Effects carry operation identity, duplicate scope, durable intent/outcome, retry limits and explicit unknown-outcome reconciliation ownership.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: No local idempotency mechanism is described as end-to-end exactly once.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Material structural decisions bind named reliability, security, recoverability, operability, maintainability, performance and local-first characteristics to owner decisions and gates.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: An architecture style does not supply measurements or rationale by itself.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The ADRs define ORG/TDD invariants and fitness evidence, with 64 noncompensating per-rule assessments for every exact subject; ADR-0010 additionally binds the inherited test baseline by exact path, mode, blob and content digest and makes expansion, drift, expiry and incomplete cutover independently falsifiable.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: A proxy count, baseline size or one-time document check is not proof of sustained effectiveness; all 64 per-rule and feedback/runtime results remain NOT_ASSESSED and nonsealing.

practice_applications.design_behavior: ADRs compare viable alternatives, consequences, migration, rollback, failure risks and evidence-triggered substitution instead of declaring a universally best style.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Generic style ratings cannot substitute for Ranex measurements and priorities.

practice_applications.design_behavior: The design names 34 owned bounded contexts, public surfaces and consistency/persistence authority while prohibiting context count as proof of modularity.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: More components or bounded contexts do not automatically mean better modularity; all 34 hypotheses require tracer falsification and remain runtime NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: governed_execution is explicitly central but constrained to authority-cell knowledge, public APIs, events and owned effects.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Central authority can be necessary; the risk is unbounded responsibility and knowledge, so all six declared coupling measures and triggers remain runtime NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: A local modular monolith with synchronous public APIs by default, owner outboxes where justified, and ADR-governed exceptions is explicitly selected.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Qualitative star tables are not a Ranex scoring model and async requires measured benefit.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Top-level packages and public APIs use Ranex capability/context language; delivery frameworks and vendors remain outside domain policy.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Use-case visibility does not prove one universal package layout or object model.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Volatile providers, storage, UI, legacy and extension mechanisms sit behind costed owner-defined ports; optional layers are omitted when no enacted behavior needs them.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: A boundary has cost and cannot be created ceremonially merely because a mechanism is called a detail.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Domain/application policy imports inward, cross-context imports target only public APIs, adapter types stay outside policy and composition is isolated; inherited tests move toward owning canonical boundaries and public behavior, while folder relocation alone never proves dependency direction.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The exact approved-edge and inherited-test migration contracts are defined, but actual source/test imports, public-behavior parity and destination ownership remain NOT_ASSESSED; moving a file cannot satisfy the dependency rule by itself.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Bounded contexts remain modules in one local process; a package-per-microservice alternative is rejected and future process splits require measured independent failure/change benefit and operating cost.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Neither monolith nor service topology is automatically well architected; context-quanta evidence remains a separate open item.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Internal policy is hidden behind public/test contracts and tests must use production code with no security, policy, reducer, gate or composition bypass.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The task PASS contract now requires an exact subject and every applicable evidence row noncompensatingly PASS; a production test API may never bypass authority/security and runtime parity remains NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Boundary-fit and feedback contracts measure interaction and change coupling, force representative production-shaped tracers, and require independent challenge of obscured dependencies and omitted behavior before architecture readiness can pass.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The symptoms are qualitative lenses, not additive points; the contracts define evidence to collect, while production change and unfamiliar-reader results remain NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Capability APIs and context boundaries must justify consumer-facing surface by the useful policy and volatility they hide; optional layers and shallow indirection are omitted unless enacted behavior needs them, while context-fit controls reject unbounded owners.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Interface depth is contextual and cannot justify god modules, ambiguous authority or hidden failure behavior; actual consumer burden and change locality remain NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Provider, registry, policy and assurance mechanisms remain behind one semantic owner and narrow public contracts; cross-context consumers may not import hidden types, formats, ordering or lifecycle mechanisms, while authority, denial, audit, failure and recovery facts stay explicit.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: Information hiding never authorizes concealment of required authority, security, denial, audit, failure, recovery or operational facts; source-level leakage tests remain NOT_ASSESSED.

practice_applications.design_behavior: Consequential topology, ownership, persistence and workflow choices retain multiple viable shapes, explicit tradeoffs, reversibility and falsifiers in ADRs and boundary-fit records; exemptions require accountable approval.
practice_applications.limitation_or_conflict: The requirement is proportional to consequence and uncertainty; it does not demand ceremonial alternatives for trivial, readily reversible local choices.

runtime_claim: No production source, test lane, built artifact, deployed system, operational outcome, book-practice effectiveness or runtime conformance is claimed by this design-time profile.
